name: Gathering Together
theme: Gathering Together draws many parts toward a shared center. A group becomes meaningful when it is held by purpose, care, and remembrance.
basicInterpretation: Bring people, resources, or thoughts into one place. What gathers now needs tending, leadership, and a reason larger than habit.
reflectionPrompt: What center is calling scattered things together?

reversed.theme: Turned around, Gathering Together becomes Hexagram 46, Pushing Upward. This other side brings in the atmosphere of ascent, gradual growth, effort, asking how the situation may look from another threshold.
reversed.reflection: Let Pushing Upward widen the reading rather than replace it. Consider what another person, timing, or hidden part of you might see when the pattern is viewed from the far side.

opposite.theme: The contrast to Gathering Together is Hexagram 26, Great Taming. Where the primary pattern emphasizes assembly, community, focus, this complementary field points toward restraint, stored power, cultivation.
opposite.reflection: This is not the main movement of the reading, but it shows what balances or challenges it. Notice where Great Taming names the medicine, shadow, or unchosen path beside the situation.
